summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Colaboradores Multi-Vínculos Import feature. All backend API tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI tests passed - login, empresa selection, colaboradores page navigation, and import modal all working correctly. The multi-vínculos feature correctly extracts multiple employees from a single document using AI.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-vínculos import feature is fully working. The flow is: 1) User opens 'Importar Documento' modal, 2) Selects empresa and document type, 3) Uploads PDF/image with multiple employees, 4) AI extracts all colaboradores, 5) User reviews each one in the review modal with navigation arrows, 6) User clicks 'Salvar Todos' to batch save. Backend endpoints: POST /api/colaboradores/importar (AI extraction), POST /api/colaboradores/salvar-lote (batch save). Frontend page at /colaboradores with import modal.
